effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] By placing 3 Digimon cards with the [Ver.5] trait from your trash face down as this Digimon's bottom digivolution cards, it may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [Ver.5] trait in the hand or trash.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [On Deletion] ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
